description: Check a domain that is not working: whether the name resolves in public DNS, then the eleven-check audit of its zone, each row ok, warn, fail or skipped with why. Use it first for a broken site or domain (DNS only, not HTTP or TLS), then dig for one record, trace for the delegation and dnssec_chain for DNSSEC. Measured from the isitdns edge and its probes, never the caller's network, with no key and a limit of 100 calls a minute per address. from moves the recursion, TTL and UDP truncation rows to that region's probe. A repeat within 300 s can come from the stored audit, marked stored.

from.description: Ask from the probe in this region

name.description: The domain to audit. Also as "domain"; a URL is read as its host.

name: check_domain

api.description: The /api GET that asks it again, as a new reading

askAgain.description: The isitdns.net page that asks it again, when one does

checks.description: The eleven rows: id, label, status, detail, receipt ids

receipts.description: One per DNS read: what, of whom, from where, when, rcode, flags, EDE, ms, answer

resolves.description: The first line: state, the line, the receipt ids it rests on

summary.description: Counts of ok, warn, fail and skip rows

title: Check a domain's DNS
